returns.problem: If an item arrives damaged, faulty or is not what you ordered, tell us within 48 hours of delivery or collection with your order number and a photo. We will replace it or refund you in full, including delivery, and arrange the return at no cost to you.
returns.changeOfMind: Changed your mind? You can return unopened, unused items in their original packaging with the seal intact within 7 days of delivery or collection. Contact us first with your order number; return delivery is at your cost, or you can drop the item at a CNM Essentials store.
nonReturnable: Opened or used fragrances, room sprays, diffusers and refills
Opened body care and hair care products
Items without their original packaging, unless they arrived faulty
returns.refunds: Once we receive and check a returned item, we refund you within 5 business days to your original payment method (or as a bank transfer for cash and in-store payments). Your bank may take a few extra days to show it. Instead of a refund you can choose an exchange or store credit.
returns.howTo: Email or call CNM Essentials customer care with your order number, or visit a CNM Essentials store with your receipt.
